_note: Hal Schram Mr. Basketball voting for Greater Lansing players who finished behind the winner (winners are in the build's mr_basketball list). place: finishing place in the voting; points: voting points. Places 1-5 show as 'Finalist'; 6th and lower as '[place] in Voting', since the award named no short list then. 'years' is how many players the source lists each year (winner included); the ballot was cut to five finalists from 2006-07. Sources: peschstats.com for 1981-2019 (Jack's text), detroitpslbasketball.com for 2020-26, BCAM's 2005-06 vote sheet. 'retro': BCAM Retro Mr. Basketball (1920-80) winners not in the build's list (Harry Kipke) and nominees; senior: false when the nominee was not a senior that season.
